pages.title: Datapack Overrides
pages.text: Nourished uses a three-layer override system:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Bundled defaults$() — curated food classifications that ship with the mod$(li)$(thing)Config$() — server owners can tune any mechanic$(li)$(thing)Datapacks$() — always win, full control over food classifications$(br2)Datapacks can reclassify any food, add foods Nourished doesn't know about, or remove foods from a group entirely.

pages.title: Datapack Overrides
pages.text: No code forks, no mixins, and no hard dependencies are required to integrate with Nourished via datapacks.$(br2)For mod developers looking to integrate via Java, Nourished provides a stable public API. See the Nourished documentation on GitHub for details.
